AP_matched_original_cycle_states.Scope: Original cycle routine versus ROI routine with identical prepared inputs and coincident anchors; not full native localization equivalence

MB_matched_original_script.Scope: Original script and ROI bridge on identical full-file audio with coincident FricLoc anchors; does not assert equivalence after changing separate ROI edges/crops.

Numerical_helpers.Smooth_reference: Independent direct means, documented finite uniformly indexed vector domain
Numerical_helpers.Limitations: Smooth is checked against documented finite-vector semantics, not an installed Curve Fitting Toolbox binary. Autocorr and procrustes checks cover mathematical finite-vector AP call forms, not the full toolbox APIs or degenerate inputs.

Optional_native_toolbox_binaries.Scope: Native binary comparisons only when installed. Skips are not passes. No full toolbox API or interactive localization equivalence is claimed.

Four_method_application_integration.ROIs: Same .48–.63 s /f/ boundaries for all methods
Four_method_application_integration.Dispatch: Actual application Python and MATLAB bridge entry points
Four_method_application_integration.Scope: Integration, normal returns, output shape, accepted-side reference-cycle normalization and native rejection behavior; no accuracy or native-localization claim. A method may reject both fixtures; its accepted-value normalization is then not exercised by this integration layer.

Real_corpus.Cluster_covariance: Direct participant score-sandwich with finite-sample correction

Limit: The executed comparisons cover the specified finite-vector operators, matched preparation and anchors, and application dispatch routes. Native automatic localization and complete optional-toolbox APIs are outside this test scope.
